sources.population: Pinggu district northeast Beijing, March 2012-May 2013; two-stage stratified cluster sample; 5004 invited, 3350 responded, 226 lacking retinal photography or plasma glucose excluded; N=3124 including 165 known diabetes. Exact age eligibility delegated to an unadmitted reference.
sources.measurement: BMI measured weight/height squared kg/m^2; fasting plasma glucose mmol/L; HbA1c percent. Detailed glycaemic assays/fasting duration delegated to unadmitted reference. Table 1 arithmetic means and individual SDs; raw proportions.

sources.population: Singapore Prospective Study Program 2004-2007 follow-up of four previous population surveys with minority oversampling; N=3895 without known diabetes or antidiabetic treatment, including 2697 Chinese, 633 Malay and 565 Indian. Source flow inconsistency: 5157 examinations minus stated exclusions 325, 932 and 2 equals 3898, whereas reported analytic N and ethnic counts total 3895. Retain reported N=3895; unexplained difference of three, no invented exclusion and no model parameter depends on its resolution.
sources.measurement: Ten-hour overnight fast; venous plasma fluoride oxalate samples, enzymatic ADVIA2400 glucose mmol/L; Bio-Rad Variant II HPLC HbA1c percent, NGSP/DCCT traceable. Measured BMI; Pearson BMI association uses log BMI. Table 1 parentheses are SE, some means adjusted; not used as individual SD. Table 2 unstandardized conditional coefficients; analyses unweighted.

sources.population: Changchun six-community REACTION baseline 2011-2012, age>=40, residence>=5 years and mobile; excludes prior diabetes, recent specified clinical events, anemia history, glucocorticoids and missing glycaemic data; N=7611. Context only.
sources.measurement: 8-14h overnight fast; venous plasma glucose oxidase ADVIA2400; fingertip blood HbA1c HPLC Bio-Rad. Table 2 arithmetic mean and SD.

sources.population: Hoorn Netherlands: first wave 1989-1992 age49-75 N2309; second 2006-2007 age40-65 N2619. Known diabetes/medications and specified missing/extreme dietary data excluded. First wave excludes non-Caucasians; two independent samples. Context only.
sources.measurement: FPG/OGTT; glucose dehydrogenase in first wave and oxidase in second; HbA1c HPLC with differing methods, second DCCT standardized. Small missingness multiply imputed. Table 1 correlations Spearman; Table 2 continuous predictors per SD and BMI quartiles, rich adjustment.
